cases.name: the fatal classes name only the known classes and keep the moment they were seen

the durable halt state is halted while there are more halts than recoveries, and numbers both append-only
the durable halt state counts a cell's record and failed attempts, legacy infrastructure attempts included
the runner lock admits one live holder, reports it to a second runner, and reads a dead holder as stale
the runner lock tells a reused pid from the recorded process by its start time
the runner lock terminates an owned process group within the deadline and reports one already gone
revalidation passes when every pin holds and names each pin that does not
the endpoint instance reads the port from the endpoint URL

the endpoint instance reads a restart as a different instance and a dead endpoint as a problem
the endpoint instance probes /models, lists the model ids, and turns every failure into a named problem rather than a throw
the endpoint instance watches the listener and reports once when it stops or is replaced, within one interval
